pull_request.title: Software: Add node-aware ACTS Spack workflow skill
pull_request.head: software/acts-spack-skill
pull_request.body:
Adds a reusable `acts-spack` skill for the user-provided ACTS setup script and `setup_spack`, with a verified-node registry and a preflight that warns before relying on an unknown node, missing prerequisites, changed environment fingerprints or unavailable full sources.

Verified on **acts-mac-studio-01.cern.ch** (Darwin arm64):

- DD4hep **1.37**, including DDG4, and Geant4 **11.4.1** are installed with headers/CMake packages.
- `setup_spack` activates the environment; additionally sourcing `thisdd4hep.sh` is needed for Python imports. DD4hep and DDG4 then import successfully.
- All **12** Geant4 dataset directories report installed, despite the package's `~data` variant.
- A C++ smoke fixture compiles, links and runs against DDCore/DDG4/Geant4.
- **Neither full source tree is staged.** Source-level requests warn separately. `spack location -s` only prints a possible stage path; `--source-dir` establishes the observed absence.

Only this node is verified. Full event simulation, source downloads, dependency changes and detector geometry are outside this change. The shared setup script/configuration is not copied into Git. Setup/lockfile fingerprints and exact package hashes retain local provenance.

The skill is installed in the local Codex skills directory; its repository copy is canonical. AGENTS.md routes dependent requests through the preflight, and CI exercises portable synthetic node-warning tests without needing Spack. The dashboard fixture now includes `skills/` so it can resolve this new evidence directory.

Validation: runtime imports, dataset checks, C++ configure/build/run, skill validation, installed-copy comparison and five preflight tests pass. Dashboard/log validation and build also pass. All 26 dashboard tests pass after the fixture correction, alongside 15 logging/document-link tests. The real-diff Software PR tracking check also passes.

[Skill and usage](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/c092a1b94c4dd006c17dda510a2c9b78af0b2e60/skills/acts-spack/SKILL.md) · [Verified node and capabilities](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/c092a1b94c4dd006c17dda510a2c9b78af0b2e60/skills/acts-spack/references/nodes.json)
